loading.title: Opening your line…
loading.body: We're fetching what the network says about it.

empty.title: You don't have a line yet
empty.body: A plan with an eSIM or internet calling will show up here once it's set up.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

number.label: Your number
number.pending: Your number is being assigned. We'll show it here as soon as the network gives us one.
number.notIncluded: This plan doesn't include a phone number.

next.installTitle: One step left: install your eSIM
next.installBody: Your profile is ready. Installing it puts the line on this phone.
next.awaitingProfileBody: The network hasn't handed us your profile yet. This usually takes a few minutes.
next.awaitingProfileFootnote: You don't need to keep the app open.
next.awaitingActivationBody: Your profile is on this phone. The network still has to switch the line on, which is a separate step we don't control.
next.suspendedBody: It won't carry calls or data until it's topped up.
next.expiredBody: Its allowance is no longer available.
next.readyBody: Nothing to do here. Your balance and call rates are below.

usage.label: What's left
usage.neverReported: The network hasn't reported any usage on this line yet, so this is what you bought rather than what's left.
usage.stale: This reading is older than usual. Your real balance may be lower.
usage.provisional: Some of this usage is still being confirmed and may change.
usage.pendingTopUp: A top-up you've paid for isn't usable yet. We're waiting for the network to apply it.

restriction.noEnforcement: Nothing at the network is capping this line. We count usage as it's reported, which can arrive late.
restriction.confirmedLimit: The network has confirmed a cap of {{amount}}.

calling.label: Calls
calling.nativeAvailable: This line can make calls from your phone's normal dialer.

nativeUnavailable.no_carrier_line: This is an internet-calling plan, so it doesn't use your phone's dialer.
nativeUnavailable.line_not_provisioned: This line isn't set up with the network yet, so it can't make calls.
nativeUnavailable.voice_not_enabled: The network hasn't enabled calls on this line. It carries data only.
nativeUnavailable.line_not_active: This line isn't active yet, so it can't make calls.
nativeUnavailable.unknown: We can't confirm whether this line can make calls.

calling.internetDialerUnavailable: Calling from inside the app isn't available yet. Calls go through your phone's own dialer.
calling.guideAction: How to call on this line

tariff.label: Call rates
tariff.version: Rates version {{version}}. Charges appear after a call ends.
tariff.none: No call rates have been published for this plan, so we can't show what calls cost.

install.title: Install your eSIM
install.privacyProtected: Screenshots are blocked on this screen. Your activation code can only be used once, so keep it off other screens too.
install.privacyIosWarning: iPhone doesn't let us block screenshots. Your activation code can only be used once — don't screenshot or share this screen.
install.privacyFailedWarning: We couldn't block screenshots on this screen. Your activation code can only be used once — don't screenshot or share it.
install.revealBody: We'll show your activation code once you're ready to install. Have your phone's eSIM settings open, or use the button we show next.
install.revealFootnote: Opening this screen doesn't use up your code.
install.shownBefore: This code has been shown {{count}} times. If you didn't do that, your eSIM may already be installed on another device — contact support before continuing.
install.manualTitle: Enter these in your phone's eSIM settings
install.manualHint: Some phones ask for one combined code instead of two fields. Both are the same profile.
install.invoked: Your phone is asking you to confirm the install. Finish there, then come back.
install.guideGeneric: These are the usual steps for Android. Your phone's menu names may differ slightly.
install.noReinstall: This profile can only be downloaded once. If you change or reset your phone, you'll need to buy a new plan — that's a limit of the eSIM standard, not a policy.
install.errorTitle: We couldn't get your activation code

guide.title: Calling on this line
guide.availableForVoice: The network says this line can make calls.
guide.caveat: We can't set this for you, and we can't see which line you pick — your phone doesn't tell apps either. Opening the dialer isn't proof a call went out on this line.

calls.chooseLine: Find this line in the list and make sure it's turned on.
calls.setDefaultVoice: Tap Default Voice Line and choose it.

data.openCellularData: In the same Cellular screen, tap Cellular Data.

data.openSims: In the same SIMs screen, find Mobile data.
